meta.assumptions_note: Default contribution margin (0.30) and cost per email ($0.05) are business assumptions.

units.qini_raw: Cumulative incremental visits above control across targeted population
units.qini_per_N: Incremental visits per customer targeted (qini_raw / N_test)
units.qini_normalized: Normalized Qini coefficient replicating sklift (area between curve and random diagonal, divided by maximum possible area)
units.auuc_norm: Area Under Uplift Curve above random targeting diagonal (raw incremental visit units)
units.auuc_perf: AUUC normalized by the theoretical perfect uplift curve replicating sklift (ratio in [0, 1])
units.uplift_top30: Observed percentage point uplift in visit rate (treated rate minus control rate) within the top 30% scored customers
